conviction_note: Near-non-result: the operational read (Jubilee running well above the rate the Q3 guide seems to assume, September note prepayments, RBL refi due in Q4) leans mildly positive. Against it are a 0-for-5 reaction history (the Q2 2026 EPS beat was sold -5.95%), a likely GAAP loss from hedge mark-to-market after Brent ran from $72 to ~$104 in the quarter, and a stock trading above the sell-side's average target. That nets to a small negative findings sum (-0.5) and p_up 48 on a 6.5% absolute move. The 17% option-implied move is not used at face value: the ATM spread is 40% of mid.

findings.finding: Jubilee (38.6% Kosmos WI) gross oil was running above 94,000 bopd on 2026-07-14 per the operator, against a Q2 average of ~72,000. J50-P came onstream in early August 'in line with expectations', and on 2026-09-28 Tullow said key wells were 'outperforming decline expectations' with FPSO uptime >99%. At ~88-92k gross average, Kosmos Ghana net comes to ~42-44k boepd (Q2: 36.3k). With GTA ~15k and GoM 13-15k, Q3 net production lands at ~71-74k boepd against the 68-72k guide, i.e. at or above the top end, which could also firm FY 69-74k toward the top.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 production of 71.4k landed inside the 70-74k guide and the stock fell -5.95% (2026-08-03) on the lower Q3 guide. In Q1 2026 (-4.59%) it fell on a miss. Production in line has not been paid; the name is 0-for-5 on prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 guide was set on 2026-08-03 at 68-72k, below Q2's 71.4k, and the stock sold off on it. Consensus EPS rose ~31% over the last month per Chartmill, but that tracks the oil price, not volume. If the market expected a top-end print, you would expect a pre-print volume upgrade or a firmer FY range in previews, and I found neither. The caveat is that revenue rests on the guided 2.75 Ghana liftings, not on production, so the excess volume mostly becomes underlift and Q4 revenue, and the reported-quarter revenue/EPS effect is small.
findings.independence: Tullow (Jubilee operator) H1 results 2026-09-28: https://www.energy-pedia.com/news/general/tullow-oil-announces-2026-half-year-results-205455, and Tullow trading statement 2026-08-05: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tullow-oil--tlw/trading-statement/9704842. Different issuer, same field.

findings.finding: Brent front-month went from $72 on 1 July to a $109 peak on 15 September and averaged ~$104 in the last two weeks of Q3 (EIA, 2026-10-05). Kosmos carries ~3.25 mmbbl of H2 2026 hedges (Brent swaps at $70.62, WTI swaps at $64.83, collars with a $75.51 ceiling) and 7.0 mmbbl of 2027 hedges with a ~$84 ceiling, so Q3 GAAP should carry a large unrealized derivative loss and probably a headline net loss. Q2 GAAP was +$184.8M including a +$51.8M derivative gain. The adjusted EPS that consensus tracks excludes the unrealized loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 2026 derivative loss was -$200.2M, and Q1 2026 was a GAAP-loss quarter that sold off -4.59%. UK press headlines GAAP swings ('Kosmos swings to second-quarter profit', AJ Bell). No clean prior test of a mark-to-market loss alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Most likely largely priced: the hedge book is in the Q2 release and the oil path is public. What is not visible is how retail and UK-listing headline readers take a 'swing to loss' on a pre-UK-open release. This sits below operating income with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Hedge book from the Q2 2026 release: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/kosmos-energy-di---kos/second-quarter-results-/9699682 (company document). The oil path is EIA; independent sources, one inference.

findings.finding: Q3 realization timing: Tullow's two July Ghana cargoes (one Jubilee, one TEN) realized ~$87/bbl, against Kosmos's Q2 oil realization of $108.57/bbl. In mid-September Dated Brent spot reached ~$132 against $109 futures, a ~$23 physical premium. Ghana cargoes price off Dated Brent, so any Kosmos Ghana lifting in September likely realized above a futures-average model (~$85-86, the Q3 Brent forecasts of EIA/Citi/JPM). Q3 hedge cash losses should also be far smaller than Q2's -$105.4M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: adjusted EPS of $0.11 beat a ~$0.09 consensus on high realizations and the stock still fell -5.95%. Realization beats have not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Kosmos's lifting dates are not public, and consensus models usually use average futures. If the market had priced a dated-premium realization, Q3 revenue estimates would sit well above the ~$400M I can rebuild at ~$85-90; the $419M high estimate suggests some do. The bar is disputed, so this is capped small.
findings.independence: Dated-vs-futures spread from EIA 2026-10-05: https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=68245. Proxy (partner realization plus macro), not a Kosmos number.

findings.finding: Kosmos made two $25M partial optional redemptions of its 7.750% 2027 senior notes (8-Ks of 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-21, redeemed 18 and 30 September) and reserves the right to do more. The Q2 release targets completion of the RBL refinancing (borrowing base cut to ~$1.2bn in spring) in Q4 2026, and net debt reduction of ~20% y/y. The Q3 release is the natural place to announce RBL completion or progress and the Q3 net-debt step.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financing news has been tied to rallies: the Jan 2026 $350M Nordic bond and debt-reduction updates came during a +215% YTD run (Barchart, March 2026). No clean print-day test.
findings.why_not_priced: The redemptions are public 8-Ks, but small and unreported in the press (no wire coverage found). They show free cash beyond what the RBL needs, which de-risks the Q4 refinancing. If priced, you would expect the 'leveraged E&P refinancing risk' discount to show in previews; the sell-side's 'Reduce' consensus suggests it has not been removed. What the money buys: it pays down near maturities, so the sign is positive or zero.
findings.independence: Second 8-K, 2026-09-08: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509991/000150999126000051/kos-20260908.htm (same issuer, same programme). RBL target from the Q2 release: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/kosmos-energy-di---kos/second-quarter-results-/9699682

findings.why_not_priced: A reaction pattern rather than a fact, and it may be in the price via the -3% five-day drift into the print. If the market had fully adjusted, you would expect the stock to stop drifting lower into prints, and it has not (-3.0% over 5 days).
findings.independence: Q2 2026 beat ($0.11 adjusted versus a ~$0.09 bar): https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/kosmos-energy-di---kos/second-quarter-results-/9699682 and the TradersUnion snapshot cited in search. Shares the baseline's data.

findings.finding: On ~2026-09-29 an ICC tribunal upheld Ghana's $393M tax assessment on Tullow Ghana (business-interruption insurance proceeds, 2016-2019, plus a 100% penalty). Kosmos has had its own disputed GRA back-tax claim since 2023, subject and amount unstated. Precedent risk could prompt a contingency disclosure or accrual in the Q3 10-Q.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody has linked the Tullow ruling to Kosmos, and the Kosmos claim's subject is unknown, so this is a weak inference. If priced, Kosmos previews would mention Ghana tax risk, and I found none.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and an unreliable 17% straddle. My mild operational positive cuts against the name's 0-for-5 reaction history and the recent -3% drift, and I let the reaction history dominate, so the net is slightly negative.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a reaction; name sells beats): production finding +0.8 -> +0.5.
Rule 6 (bar disputed, three EPS sources at $0.07/0.08/0.09; production inside/at top of guide): realization finding +0.4 -> +0.3, capped small.
Rule 2 (one-off below operating income): hedge mark-to-market finding -0.4 -> -0.3.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the note redemptions fund deleveraging, so the sign stays positive; RBL announcement timing unconfirmed, +0.4 -> +0.3.
Rule 5 / single source: Jefferies/PT positioning finding -0.3 -> -0.2.
'Asking what the market missed generates pessimism': p_up 47 -> 48. The reaction-history finding (-1.0) and the Ghana tax proxy (-0.1) are left standing.
